_comment: Limits for the /tokens context-files view. 'hard' entries are harness limits verified in the Claude Code docs (source quoted); 'budgets' are kuhy's own soft targets and may be edited freely. A rule applies to a file when every given 'kind' / 'name' / 'standing' matches (kind: substring of the store's kind; name: exact file name).

hard.name: MEMORY.md
hard.why: auto-memory index: only the first 200 lines or 25KB (25,000 bytes = 24.4 KiB) are loaded
hard.source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory#auto-memory: 'The first 200 lines of MEMORY.md, or the first 25KB, whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation.'

hard.why: a CLAUDE.md over 4 MiB is skipped entirely
hard.source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory: 'Claude Code loads a CLAUDE.md file of up to 4 MiB in full and skips a larger file.'

hard.why: a rules file over 4 MiB is skipped
hard.source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory: 'Claude Code skips a file over 4 MiB.'

hard.why: description + when_to_use are cut at 1,536 characters in the skill listing
hard.source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills: 'the combined description and when_to_use text is truncated at 1,536 characters in the skill listing'

budgets.name: MEMORY.md
budgets.why: MEMORY.md target: 12.2 KiB, half the 25,000-byte read limit

measure_command: wc -lc {paths}  # tokens ~= bytes / 4; or open /tokens -> Context files
